units.source_text: 我那时还年轻，喜欢钻牛角尖，至少在先生看来是这样的。

en.t: I was still young then, and I tended to get caught up in trifles, at least as Sensei saw it.

units.source_text: 对我来说，先生的话要比学校的讲义更有教益，先生的思想比教授的见解更为难得。

en.t: To me, Sensei's words were more instructive than the lectures at school, and his thoughts were more precious than the professors' opinions.

units.source_text: 一句话，洁身自好、少言寡语的先生，仿佛比站在讲坛上教导我的那些教授更了不起。

en.t: In short, Sensei, who kept himself pure and spoke little, seemed somehow greater than the professors who taught me from their platforms.
Do not be too infatuated with me.
I think this way only after having come to my senses.

units.source_text: 我回答时充满了自信，而先生对我的自信却未加理睬。

en.t: I answered with complete confidence, but Sensei paid no attention to that confidence of mine.

units.source_text: “你是一时头脑发热，热情一退就会厌倦的。

en.t: You are merely carried away for the moment; once the fever cools, you will grow tired of it.

units.source_text: 你现在的盲目迷恋，使我感到痛苦。

en.t: Your blind devotion to me now causes me pain.

units.source_text: 预感到今后将会发生在你身上的变化，我就更加痛苦了。”

en.t: When I foresee the change that will come over you from now on, it pains me even more.

units.source_text: “您认为我那么轻浮，那么不值得信任吗？”

en.t: Do you think I am so frivolous, so unworthy of trust?

units.source_text: “您的意思是说同情我，但不能信任我，对吗？”

en.t: You mean that you pity me, but cannot trust me, is that it?
Sensei looked out at the garden with an embarrassed expression.

units.source_text: 庭院里，不久前还开满枝头的深红色茶花，现在一朵也看不见了。

en.t: In the garden, the deep red camellias that had covered the branches not long before were now nowhere to be seen.

units.source_text: 先生喜欢从客厅里眺望茶花。

en.t: Sensei liked to gaze at the camellias from the sitting room.

units.source_text: “我说的不可信任，并不是说不信任你，

en.t: When I say I cannot trust, I do not mean that I cannot trust you in particular,
but that I cannot trust human beings as a whole.
